title.narrative: Programa de Modernizacin del Sector Pblico
Public Sector Modernization Programme

description.narrative: El objetivo principal de esta operacin es aumentar la eficacia del Gobiernode Barbados para mejorar la competitividad de la economa del pas. Eso se lograr con (i) un mayor uso delcanal digital para el acceso de particulares y empresas a servicios pblicos y (ii) una mayor eficiencia de laadministracin pblica y el fortalecimiento de las aptitudes del sector pblico para operar en una economa digital

The main objective of this operation is to improve the effectiveness of theGovernment of Barbados to enhance the competitiveness of its economy. This will be achieved through:(i) increasing the adoption of the digital channel to access public services by individuals and businesses; and (ii) anenhancement of the efficiency in the civil service and strengthening the skills in the public sector for a digitaleconomy.
